auth_methods.quote: OAuth2.0 requests are usually authenticated with an access token, which is passed as bearer token.

access_notes.value: Free Edition includes 5,000 API credits per 24-hour rolling window, so a developer can self-serve API access on the free tier. Larger volumes require a paid edition (Standard/Starter, Professional, Enterprise/Zoho One, Ultimate/CRM Plus) or purchased add-on credits (support@zohocrm.com). Credentials are OAuth 2.0 tokens from a connected application; there is no separate API key. Official MCP servers are provisioned per-organization via Zoho's Server Registry, so no single public MCP endpoint URL is published.
access_notes.quote: If your organization requires more API credits than the allowed limit for your edition, write to support@zohocrm.com and purchase additional credits.

official_mcp_server.quote: Zoho CRM provides these as pre-built MCP servers, so you don't need to build, host, or maintain any infrastructure.

rate_limits.value: Credit-based limits per 24-hour rolling window; per-user/app concurrency caps by edition: Free 5, Standard/Starter 10, Professional 15, Enterprise/Zoho One 20, Ultimate/CRM Plus 25
rate_limits.quote: | Edition | Concurrency Limits for a User/App | | --- | --- | | Free | 5 | | Standard/Starter | 10 | | Professional | 15 | | Enterprise/Zoho One | 20 | | Ultimate/CRM Plus | 25 |

webhooks.quote: Webhooks in Zoho CRM allow you to send real-time data from Zoho CRM to external applications or services when specific events occur such as Record creation, update, or deletion.

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: For sandbox, the domain would be sandbox.zohoapis.{domain}.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: URL-path versioning with version segment in the endpoint (/crm/{version}/); v8 is the current documented API version. No deprecation or sunset policy was present in the supplied evidence.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: APIs and References | Zoho CRM V8 APIs

verdict_reason: Zoho CRM publishes a broad v8 REST API with a full API directory and OAuth 2.0 authentication. Access is self-serve: the Free Edition already includes 5,000 API credits per rolling 24-hour window, with higher caps on paid editions. Zoho also ships vendor-operated pre-built MCP servers for CRM operations, so an agent integration can be built without sales contact.
open_questions: The Composio catalog check returned toolkit_exists=true but the returned items list only zoho_projects, zoho_books, zoho_salesiq, zoho_billing, zoho_work_drive, zoho_analytics, zoho_cliq and zoho_people; no zoho_crm slug appears, so a dedicated Zoho CRM toolkit is unconfirmed from this evidence.
Official SDK languages could not be verified: SDK search results (zoho-crm-sdks.html, client-side-sdks, server-side-sdks) were not included in the SOURCES text, so sdk_languages is left null.
No documented API deprecation/sunset policy appears in the supplied sources; only the path-level version segment (/crm/v8/) is evidenced.
The exact hosted MCP endpoint URL is provisioned per-organization through Zoho's Server Registry and is not published in the evidence, so the official MCP docs URL is used as the value.

Whether the Zoho CRM Free Edition gives full self-serve API access versus a time-limited trial is inferred from the Free Edition credit table; the pricing page text confirming free-plan signup was not fully captured.
